localInfra.title: Local multimodal service (local-multimodal-infra)
localInfra.subtitle: AstrBot's first-tier local service: speech recognition, speech synthesis, embeddings, rerank, content moderation and realtime voice are set up here; plugins call the same server through Context.get_local_infra().
localInfra.enableHint: When off, AstrBot uses none of its services and plugins get no client.
localInfra.baseUrlHint: The server's HTTP address (without /v1), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:17890. Realtime voice uses ws://…/v1/realtime.
localInfra.tokenHint: One of the server's LOCAL_MCP_INFER_TOKENS, if it has any; sent as Authorization: Bearer.
localInfra.timeoutHint: How long one request may take (synthesizing a long text can be slow).
localInfra.statusOff: The local multimodal service is off.
localInfra.statusError: Cannot list models: {error}. Switched-on services keep trying as configured.
localInfra.statusOld: The server is too old to list task kinds, so models cannot be matched; it picks the model for each service.
localInfra.servicesHint: Each service is on by default and uses the server's first enabled model of its kind, unless you pick one or switch it off. Speech recognition, speech synthesis, embeddings and rerank appear as providers local_infra/… wherever a provider is chosen.

stt.name: Speech recognition
stt.hint: Provider local_infra/stt, selectable in the speech-to-text settings.

tts.name: Speech synthesis
tts.hint: Provider local_infra/tts, selectable in the text-to-speech settings.

embedding.name: Embeddings
embedding.hint: Provider local_infra/embedding, for knowledge bases. An automatically selected model is saved as the current choice and is not switched when the server enables another embedding model later, keeping the knowledge base vector space consistent.

rerank.name: Rerank
rerank.hint: Provider local_infra/rerank, for knowledge base retrieval.

moderation.name: Content moderation
moderation.hint: Checks messages before they go to cloud models; each platform chooses on, text only or off in its settings.

realtime_voice.name: Realtime voice
realtime_voice.hint: Used when the Codex page's realtime voice runs on the local backend.

localInfra.serverPicks: The server uses its enabled moderation models

state.no_model: No usable model on the server

localInfra.refAudioHint: The voice to clone (WAV, relative to the data directory or absolute); empty: the model's default voice.
localInfra.refTextHint: What the reference audio says (helps Qwen3-TTS clone the voice); optional.

moderation.blockedReplyHint: What the bot replies to a blocked message. Empty: the built-in reply.
moderation.thresholdHint: A text is flagged when 1 - p(safe) exceeds this (0 to below 1, default 0.9). Lower is stricter.
moderation.nsfwThresholdHint: An image is flagged when its NSFW probability exceeds this (0 to below 1, default 0.5). Lower is stricter.
moderation.nsfwLabelsHint: Which classifier levels count as NSFW; none selected: the server's setting.
moderation.categoriesHint: Text (also text read from images) is blocked only for the selected categories; none selected means all.

localInfra.modelsHint: From the server's /v1/models; models are enabled and downloaded on the server.
localInfra.noModels: No model information (service off or unreachable).
localInfra.loadFailed: Cannot load the local multimodal service settings
